scope: Controlled lab read-ahead comparison A0(128 KiB), B1/B2/B3(1024 KiB), A1(128 KiB) on one owned VM. This is not final production qualification.
causal_verdict: The binary pre-log phase improves during all three B runs and slows again on return-A. End-to-end benefit is not sufficient or repeatable: B3 fails. Shared host/device pressure and acceptance-to-boot variation prevent assigning all timing changes to read-ahead.

intervention.only_planned_change: Same early udev rule placement with read_ahead_kb value 128 or 1024; readiness checks, locks and image unchanged.
intervention.application_timing_limit: Postboot effective-value verification is not a timestamp proving the rule applied before every early-boot read. Reads before udev application are outside the intervention.

cycles.boot_origin_note: Correlation uncertainty window, not measured shutdown duration; a negative lower bound reflects uncertainty. Shutdown/reboot and guest startup remain separate stages.

backup.archive_identity_scope: Frozen collector checks unique expected filename, size_bytes and encrypted flag; original API listing is not retained, so equality is not independently replayable and archive content integrity is not proven.

historical_encrypted_log_recovery.reason: Supported Tier-1/Tier-2 backup excludes Tier-3 historical logs; retaining the log passphrase alone cannot recover them.

host_pressure.window_selection: Only sample timestamps within each guest boot-to-systemd-complete interval. 20s bins overlap phase boundaries; shared host/device series include unrelated workloads.

journal_diagnostics.classification: Syntax failure: --boot and UUID were separate arguments; UUID parsed as journal match; Invalid argument. No evidence of journal absence.
Descriptor parsing failure for hyphenated old-boot UUID. No evidence of journal absence.

Canonical old-boot hexadecimal query attempted; retained result empty. Parent reports bounded 90-second transport failure/HTTP403; subsequently confirmed local completion marker and shell ready. This is not proof of absent journals.
journal_diagnostics.source_of_transport_classification: Parent-controlled console observation, not inferred from empty payload.
journal_diagnostics.followup: Separate v4 capture proves retained selected-unit prior-boot entries; original v3 transport failure is preserved.

journal_diagnostics.classification: Canonical 32-hex boot-ID queries returned actual previous-boot entries for all five cycles. Journals are retained for these queried units; no journal-absence claim.
journal_diagnostics.interpretation: Selected-unit shutdown records appear by approximately3.612/0.969/0.705/1.710/6.591 seconds after guest acceptance for A0/B1/B2/B3/A1. They do not cover the complete unmount, shutdown, firmware and reboot path or explain the entire acceptance-to-new-boot interval.

limitations: No exact execution timestamp for udev setting; pre-udev I/O is not covered.
Only one owned VM; shared host workloads and cache state were not controlled.
20-second samples overlap phase boundaries and VM latency has missing samples; no interpolation.
Sampler starts after substantial early boot; main-thread states do not represent all threads or continuous waits.
Controller boot-origin correlation includes uncertainty and is not a direct shutdown duration.
Software/signature equality means captured version/package output and signature-file size/mtime; no database content-hash claim.
First-backup identity is the frozen recorded filename/size/encryption comparison, not archive-content verification or full restored-data coverage.
Supported backup still excludes Tier-3 historical logs; passphrase possession alone does not establish their recovery.
b579 artifact predates later product fixes; this experiment grants no production approval or scanner/full-disk remediation acceptance.
No private configuration values, credentials, raw logs, IP addresses, keys or certificates are embedded.
preserved_failures: Original E0 baseline remains PASS/FAIL/FAIL at113.906/138.328/161.703 seconds.
A0 FAIL178.750; B3 FAIL159.859; return-A1 FAIL143.781 remain failures despite successful backup/state/PONG checks.
A1 agent and agent_version checks remain false after public readiness in three samples; not merely operator latency.
Historical597-second recovery and10-second backup timeout remain unresolved and are not explained by this experiment.
Journal syntax, descriptor and transport failures are retained as separate diagnostic outcomes.

conclusions.binary_loading_phase: Containerd pre-log A0/B1/B2/B3/A1 seconds:20.753/5.805/3.637/4.438/14.825. This reversible association is consistent with a bounded read-ahead benefit, but is not sufficient production recovery remediation.
conclusions.metadata_gap: Metadata-marker gap does not track read-ahead monotonically:11.818/3.288/2.800/4.683/0.276 seconds. Main-thread futex snapshots do not establish its blocking syscall or storage cause.
conclusions.early_boot: B3 first root mount3.018s, remount47.498s, local-fs53.376s precede its sampler57.039s. Cause is unobserved at process level.
conclusions.discard: At first B3 sample one completed discard totals40ms. This does not directly explain47-second root-remount timestamp; aggregate request times are not wall-clock attribution.
conclusions.host_confounding: Shared-device latency/queue pressure, aggregate host load and acceptance-to-boot timing vary between runs. VM CPU-ready/co-stop/maxlimited and memory metrics are retained in native units; no percentage conversion or CPU-contention conclusion is inferred.
conclusions.production: Two B passes followed by B3 failure do not satisfy three consecutive reboots. Return-A preserves phase-level evidence but does not change this verdict.

early_boot_followup.interpretation: Successful retained initrd listing found no matching experiment readahead rule entries. Root-filesystem udev rule intervention must not be credited with changing pre-root/initrd reads. This snapshot does not timestamp rule application within each earlier run.
